name: What pipe materials are used for main water line replacement, and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What pipe materials are used for main water line replacement, and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for main water line replacement include copper, PEX (cross-linked polyethylene), and sometimes PVC for non-pressure applications. Copper is durable and long-lasting but more expensive; PEX is flexible, corrosion-resistant, and more affordable. The 'best' material is a practical tradeoff, depending on your budget, water quality, soil conditions, and the specific installation requirements of your property, which we can help you assess.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials are copper and PEX. Copper is durable but costly; PEX is flexible and affordable. The best choice depends on budget, water quality, and site conditions.
